report:
CONTRAST-ENHANCED CRANIAL MRI EXAMINATION:
Technique: Axial plane FSE T2 and FLAIR T2, coronal plane FSE T1 and sagittal plane FSE T2, 3D BRAVO after IV contrast agent injection.

Examination;
	Bone structures within the field of view and subgaleal tissue are normal.
In the evaluation of the craniofacial region structures; A left maxillary retention cyst is observed. Nasal cavity, other paranasal sinuses, and mastoid air cells are normal.

	In the evaluation of the orbits within the field of view; globes, extraorbital muscles, retrobulbar fat tissue, and optic nerves are evaluated as normal.

In the posterior fossa series; 4th ventricle is in normal location, shape, and width. Cerebellar hemispheres are observed symmetrically, gray-white matter differentiation shows no specific feature.
	Brainstem structures, pons, and midbrain are normal.
Basal cisterns are observed as open.
In slices obtained after contrast agent injection, pathological contrast enhancement was not observed.

	In the supratentorial series; white and gray matter intensities are observed as normal in both hemispheres. Ventricular system is symmetric on the midline, width compatible with age.
Basal ganglia and thalami are normal.
Cortical sulci and gyri are normal.
In slices obtained after contrast agent injection, pathological contrast enhancement was not observed.
Impression: Contrast-enhanced brain MRI findings within normal limits.
